snippet.title: Bonza Word Puzzle: Gameplay
snippet.description: http://www.bonzawordpuzzle.com. Bonza is a new type of crossword where players arrange word fragments to complete puzzles. Requiring word-power, spatial skills and a little bit of trivia knowledge. If you like a good word challenge and you enjoy pushing boxes around with your fingers, then you'll love Bonza Word Puzzle.
